title: When Sounds Turn Heads: Recovering Event Timing That Audio LLMs Fail to Say
abstract: arXiv:2611.25960v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio LLMs can know when a queried sound occurs but fail to say it. We find a few attention heads that track the queried sound: they shift when the query changes, follow the sound when it moves, and removing or blocking them often hurts the model's timestamps. Yet the answer does not express what they track. Intervals read directly from these heads outperform the model's original answer and recover events that its timestamps miss. To bring this timing into the answer, we introduce head-guided decoding, which needs no training. It keeps the model's decision on whether the sound is present and rescores its candidate timestamps with a prior from these heads. Heads selected on development data transfer unchanged to new recordings and free-text queries, where head-guided decoding improves the timestamps of three audio LLMs, scores above their head readout on every benchmark, and, in most settings, outperforms random-head guidance. On record

translated_title: 《当声音牵动注意力头：恢复音频大模型无法言说的事件时间信息》
translated_abstract: 音频大语言模型能够知道被查询的声音何时发生，却无法在回答中表达出来。我们发现少数注意力头能够追踪被查询的声音：当查询改变时它们会随之移动，当声音位置变化时它们会跟随，而移除或阻断这些注意力头往往会损害模型的时间戳预测。然而模型的回答并未表达出这些注意力头所追踪的信息。直接从这些注意力头读取的时间区间优于模型原本的回答，并能恢复其时间戳所遗漏的事件。为了将这种时间信息引入模型的回答中，我们提出了无需训练的头引导解码方法：它保留模型对声音是否存在的判断，并利用这些注意力头提供的先验对候选时间戳进行重新打分。在开发数据上选出的注意力头无需任何改动即可直接迁移到新的录音和自由文本查询上。在这些场景中，头引导解码提升了三种音频大模型的时间戳质量，在所有基准上的得分均高于直接读取注意力头的区间，并且在大多数设置下优于随机注意力头引导。
tldr: 音频大模型的少数注意力头内部已追踪到被查询声音的发生时间却无法在回答中表达，本文提出无需训练的头引导解码方法，利用这些注意力头的先验对候选时间戳重新打分，从而显著提升三种音频大模型的时间戳精度。
en_tdlr: Audio LLMs internally track queried sound timing in a few attention heads but fail to express it; we propose training-free head-guided decoding that rescores candidate timestamps using a prior from these heads, improving timestamp accuracy across three audio LLMs.
